prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence remains thin for choose_path hint, finish copy, finish hint, finish new_flow, finish redesign, home notification, sign_in copy, sign_in hint, sign_in notification, and sign_in reorder because each has only been tested once.
For choose_path copy changes (2 tests), no clear effect was seen in either test.
For choose_path redesign changes (2 tests), no clear effect was seen in either test.
For home wait_info changes (4 tests), no clear winning effect was demonstrated, with three tests showing no clear effect and one rolled back due to a guardrail.
For adoption redesign changes (2 tests), results disagree, with one winning test and one showing no clear effect.
Predictions were consistently overly optimistic compared to noise-corrected measurements across most tests.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Custom Pet Photo Tips Stage: Redesign the custom pet photo upload screen into a stage layout with live framing tips and photo picker guidelines. (why: Adoption step has the lowest completion rate (66.2%) and users submitted support tickets reporting failed or incorrect pet generation from bad photos.)
1: [home, redesign] Interactive Waiting Room Mini Activity: Redesign the pet generation wait screen into an interactive companion preview stage featuring pet idle animations and progress tracking. (why: The waiting stage takes a long median time of 201s (mean 2336s), causing drop-offs while users wait passively.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Sync & Restore Banner: Add an explicit account sync hint on the sign-in screen explaining that signing in restores previous pets and settings. (why: 8 support emails were received about pets missing or reset after signing in again, leading to drop-offs during sign in.)
3: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Badge Reward: Add an official adoption badge reward component to the adoption certificate screen to celebrate completing pet adoption. (why: Adoption drop-off is 33.8% (lowest converting step in funnel), so introducing a reward increases completion momentum.)
4: [home, notification] System Desktop Tray Status Notification: Enable desktop tray notifications to alert users when background pet processing is complete. (why: Users wait a median of 201s (mean 2336s) on the waiting screen and support tickets mention app opening / pet visibility issues.)
5: [choose_path, layout] Story Intro Card Layout Switch: Switch the initial story screen layout to card view and add a companion video preview asset. (why: choose_path sees a 23.8% initial drop-off rate, which can be improved with richer preview visual media.)
